title: Nabam Rebia v. Deputy Speaker, Arunachal Pradesh

content.caseIdentity: Nabam Rebia v. Deputy Speaker, Arunachal Pradesh, (2016) 8 SCC 1
content.holding: Governor cannot act without aid and advise of Cabinet in summoning assembly; restored dismissed government.
content.relevance: Modern milestone on gubernatorial discretion and restoration of government.
